prompt:
THE LENDING LIBRARY, the room behind the Study shelf: a small warm reading room lined floor-to-ceiling with wooden shelves of books and rolled scrolls, lit by hanging oil lamps.

Painted in a warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading — no photorealism, no line art, no text, no lettering on the spines, no watermark, NO PEOPLE and NO ANIMALS. Wide landscape, roughly 16:9, camera dead centre at standing eye height, symmetrical, the far wall of shelving filling the frame. A tall arched window high in the back wall shows deep blue night sky. A heavy wooden CHECKOUT DESK stands on the floor at the RIGHT of the frame, its top clear except for a closed ledger and a small brass lamp.

THE LEFT AND CENTRE OF THE FLOOR MUST BE COMPLETELY CLEAR AND EMPTY — no furniture, no crates, no stacks of books, no rug, nothing standing on it. A character will be drawn standing there, so anything painted into that space will be drawn over. The floor runs across the bottom quarter of the frame as plain warm timber boards.

Warm lamplight, deep violet-brown shadow, a palette of warm clay, honey timber, aged leather spines and gold, against the night outside.

FLAT SOLID MAGENTA BACKGROUND #FF00FF filling every pixel behind the figure. NOT white, NOT grey, NOT mauve, NOT a gradient, NOT a room — flat pure magenta only. No shadow on the backdrop, no ground plane, no frame, no text, no watermark.

A FULL-LENGTH STANDING FIGURE, HEAD TO FEET, both feet resting at the very bottom edge of the frame, the whole body visible from the top of the head to the soles of both shoes. NOT a bust, NOT a portrait, NOT cropped at the waist or knees. A single character, standing straight, facing the viewer, arms at a comfortable rest.

The village librarian: a warm, kindly older woman with a broad friendly smile and laugh lines, silver-streaked dark hair pinned up in a soft bun with a wooden stylus through it, small round brass spectacles on a beaded chain. She wears a long simple ankle-length linen robe in deep teal with a soft ochre shawl over one shoulder and a wide woven belt. She holds a single closed leather-bound book against her chest with both hands, and a small brass key hangs from her belt.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, matching the reference figures exactly in proportion, line weight and palette warmth. Head to feet, full length, feet at the bottom edge.
